prompt: Get the latest web user from CommCare, append " (synced from OpenFn)" to its last_name, and upload it as a user to SurveyCTO.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-commcare@latest'
    body: |
      get('/web-user', { limit: 1 });
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-surveycto@latest'
    body: |
      upsertDataset({ id: 'users', title: 'Users', idColumn: 'username' });
      uploadCsvRecords('users', state => {
        const u = state.data.objects[0];
        return [{ username: u.username, first_name: u.first_name, last_name: `${u.last_name} (synced from OpenFn)`, email: u.email }];
      });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
